analysis.rationale: Strong revenue and profit growth, expanding margins, and robust cash generation indicate improving fundamentals. International revenue share increased to 42%, diversifying revenue streams.
analysis.summary: Nephrocare Health Services reported consolidated revenue growth of 32.2% to ₹998.8 crore, adjusted EBITDA up 37.6% to ₹238.1 crore with 23.8% margin, and adjusted PAT up 74.6% to ₹128.3 crore for FY 2025-26.
